newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jilin plans new A share.
newsitem.headline: Jilin plans new A share.

text.p: China's petrochemical giant Jilin Chemical Industrial Co Ltd's board of directors said on Friday it planned to issue an additional 300 million domestic currency A shares for listing on the Shenzhen bourse.
Jilin Chemical's shareholders would meet on August 4 to vote on the equity expansion proposal, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.

The company said it aimed to launch the issue within 12 months of the shareholders' meeting and price the A shares at no less than the closing price of its H shares listed in Hong Kong one day before its board decides the issue price.
The issue needed final approval from securities authorities in Beijing, it added.
The company planned to inject the A share proceeds into ethylene production expansion and working capital, it said.
The company's principal products include petrochemical, organic chemical, dyestuff, dye intermediates and synthetic rubber.
After the A share issue, the company would have 3.711 billion outstanding shares, composed of 2.396 billion shares held by the state, 965 million H shares and 350 million A shares, it said.

The firm posted a net profit of 312 million yuan for 1996, down 58 percent from 744 million yuan for 1995 and blamed the plunge on the costs incurred in starting trial production at new facilities and the closure of other facilities for regular maintenance.
